column2: Statistical disclosure control has been applied to this table to avoid the release of confidential data.  Totals may not sum due to the disclosure control applied.

The move to publishing benefit data via the Stat-Xplore instead of the DWP Tabulation Tool has involved adopting a new disclosure control methodology, in line with other benefits published via this new tool. Although the data still comes from the same source there may be small differences in the outputs displayed using this new tool, when compared to the Tabulation Tool.
".." denotes a nil or negligible number of claimants or award amount based on a nil or negligible number of claimants.

Between May 2007 to November 2007 location information for some claimants is unavailable, causing a slight rise in the number of unknown geographies. Statistics for this period which show geography information should therefore be interpreted with care.
